title: Maryland's Best Karate

services.name: Kidz Karate (8 - 13)
services.desc: Since the age of 2, my son has struggled with his speech/ language development, focusing his attention and impulse control. He’s been labeled “aggressive,” “dangerous,” and “violent” by the people trusted to care for him. Since 2 years old, he’s been kicked out of 6 daycare centers and 3 summer camps. My son has struggled to find acceptance and a sense of belonging within institutions not particularly designed for Black boys with disabilities. We’ve since found a village of Black men at MBK who were dedicated to my son’s growth and development, not just in martial arts but in life.
